company_notes: Background: Pelagos builds route-optimization + ETA predictions for container shipping. Want ML-driven end-user chat + batch summarization for manifests.
Primary ask: Dedicated capacity with guaranteed throughput for peak booking window (11:00–13:00 UTC). Must meet tight latency SLOs for chat flows.
Purchase intent: Committed reserved pool if POC meets throughput and cost targets. Prefers annual reservation but open to phased commit after successful soak test.
Quote from CTO on call: 'We need predictable per-request latency during peak; cost variance kills our margin.'
Security: VPC + private control plane required; must pass SOC2 questionnaire and provide audit log export into Pelagos SIEM. KMS integration mandatory.
Model preferences: Start with LLaMA-3-ish open variant and evaluate quantized 4-bit versions for cost. Keep hosted-compatible variant for fallback.
Routing requirements: Regional routing to NA region, failover to EU only if NA capacity exhausted. Sticky routing for session KV cache reuse.
Cost sensitivity: Mid-high. Target amortized token cost < $0.0009 for embeddings and generation cost target of <$0.002/token at 95th percentile under batching.
Notes on infra: On-prem co-location is a future ask, but current POC will be VPC-connected Dedicated cluster (RGX/GPU pool).
Procurement: Legal requested SLA table and credit for downtime for any P95/P99 misses before procurement kickoff.

Desired SLAs discussed: P95 generation < 120ms for short-chat prompts (<=128 tokens); P99 < 420ms for 512-token bursts. Throughput target: sustained 300 req/s for chat QA flows with burst to 800 req/s for 5 minutes.
Reserved GPU planning: Initial ask 8x A100-equivalent for primary pool, auto-burst reserve of 2x for peak. Redwood recommended 6x + burst 4x after profiling; need modeling of seq length distribution.
POC scope: Load tests (steady-state 24h at 300 req/s), Soak tests (48h with diurnal pattern), Failure injection (node drain, network flaps), Quantized model parity checks across 1000 eval prompts.

Representative prompts: 'Customer: Where is my container?'; 'Summarize manifest page 12 in 3 bullets'; reranking candidate titles for ETA predictions; 2000 embedding vectors per batch for search index updates.
Metrics we will capture: p50/p95/p99 latency, cold-start tail, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, KV cache hit rate, cost per 1M tokens under observed batching, failed requests per 100k.
Recent ask from infra: trace context and sampling headers to be injected; Redwood console needs token-level cost breakdown for each route.
Legal/Procurement requests: outage credit definitions, maintenance window SLAs, data residency addendum for EU customers, indemnity clause tweaks.
Sales notes: AE to propose two contract options — (A) 12-month committed 8-GPU pool with 3-month ramp and SLA credits; (B) 6-month trial 6-GPU + burst 2-GPU with higher per-unit price.
Internal Redwood follow-ups: Run microbenchmark with Pelagos sample prompt set (attached); provide model/quantization performance matrix; propose test harness (locust + custom KV caching shim).

poc_summary: Objective: Validate Dedicated capacity meets throughput guarantees and latency SLOs under realistic traffic; demonstrate cost per token with quantized models and caching.
Test harness: Locust-based load generator + request mixer to emulate chat/embedding/rerank flows; synthetic KV cache with warm-up phase; trace injection for Redwood Console.
Traffic profile: baseline 300 req/s sustained (60% chat short prompts, 25% embeddings batch, 15% reranking); peak bursts to 800 req/s for 5 minute windows every 6 hours.
Soak plan: 48-hour soak with diurnal pattern, include scheduled node drain on hour 24 to test graceful fallback and spawn latency impact.
Acceptance criteria: p95 chat latency < 120ms, p99 chat latency < 420ms, successful end-to-end throughput >= 95% of target, no more than 0.2% failed requests, cost estimate within target range.
Deliverables: POC runbook PDF, soak test results CSV, latency breakdown slides, recommended reserved GPU sizing and SLA table.
technical_findings: Preliminary Redwood bench (internal): 6x A100-equivalent baseline reaches ~260 req/s for short-chat 128-token workloads with 2-token generation avg per step; KV cache hit ratio improves throughput by ~22%.

Quantized 4-bit results: model parity on intent classification ~98% vs fp16 on 1000 eval prompts; hallucination regression tests flagged 0.8% increased token-level divergence on long summarization tasks.
Network sensitivity: observed 30–40ms additional tail when requests cross AZ boundary; recommend single-AZ placement for strict P95 concerns or use AZ-local routing.
Autoscaling notes: Redwood recommends baseline reserved pool + burst pool with fast warm-up (<90s) for additional concurrency; need to validate warm-up cost on POC.
Failure modes tested in sim: node drain increases p99 by up to 3.5x for 90s window without cache priming; sticky session routing mitigates cache cold-starts.
